exercises.instructionEn: Look at the picture. Who are they? Can you describe them?
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmga qarang. Ular kim? Ularni tasvirlay olasizmi?
exercises.explanationUz:
RASMDA NIMA KO'RINADI:

  Baland o't orasidan ikki kishi yugurib
  bormoqda:

     • Oldinda — ERKAK: uzun OCh RANGLI
       soch, ko'k kamzul, etik
     • Orqada — AYOL: uzun QORA soch,
       jigarrang ko'ylak, marjon, YALANG
       OYOQ


JAVOB:

  'They are JOHN SMITH and POCAHONTAS.'


TASVIRLASh (NAMUNA):

  'John Smith is tall. He's got long FAIR
   hair. He wears a BLUE COAT and BOOTS.
   He is an English soldier — a captain.

   Pocahontas is slim. She's got long BLACK
   hair. She wears a BROWN DRESS and a
   NECKLACE. She is BAREFOOT. She is a
   Native American — the daughter of Chief
   Powhatan.'

  Tarjimasi:
  'Jon Smit baland bo'yli. Uning uzun och
   rangli sochi bor. U ko'k kamzul va etik
   kiyadi. U — ingliz askari, kapitan.

   Pokaxontas ozg'in. Uning uzun qora sochi
   bor. U jigarrang ko'ylak va marjon
   kiyadi. Yalang oyoq. U — Amerika tub
   aholisi, Poukatan sardorining qizi.'


⚠ TASVIRLASh QOLIPI (84 va 85-betlardan):

  'He/She is [gavda].'
  'He/She's got [rang] hair.'
  'He/She wears [kiyim].'

  Unit 4 ('Like Father, like Son') qolipi.


⚠ IKKI DUNYONING QARAMA-QARShILIGI:

  Kitob rasmni ataylab tanlagan — ikki
  personaj TO'LIQ ZID ko'rinishda:

     JOHN SMITH        POCAHONTAS
     ─────────────     ──────────────
     och rangli soch   qora soch
     ko'k kamzul       jigarrang ko'ylak
     ETIK kiygan       YALANG OYOQ
     yevropalik        tub aholi

  ⚠ 4-mashq ham shu qarama-qarshilikni
  davom ettiradi (SOLDIERS ↔ INDIANS).


FILM HAQIDA QISQAChA:

  Disney multfilmi (1995).

  1607-yil: ingliz kemasi Yangi Dunyoga
  (Amerikaga) keladi. Askarlar OLTIN
  qidiradi. Kapitan Jon Smit u yerda
  Pokaxontas bilan tanishadi.

  Ikki xalq urushga tayyorlanadi.
  Pokaxontas urushning oldini oladi.


DIQQAT — 'THE NEW WORLD':
  'the New World' = Yangi Dunyo (Amerika)
  'the Old World' = Eski Dunyo (Yevropa,
     Osiyo, Afrika)

  ⚠ Bu — YEVROPALIKLARNING nomi. Tub aholi
  uchun bu yer 'yangi' emas edi — ular u
  yerda ming yillardan beri yashardi.


DIQQAT — 'BAREFOOT':
  'barefoot' = yalang oyoq
  ('bare' = yalang'och, ochiq)


DIQQAT — 'A CHIEF':
  'a chief' = sardor, qabila boshlig'i
  'Chief Powhatan' — Pokaxontasning otasi


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  the New World = Yangi Dunyo (Amerika)
  a soldier   = askar
  a captain   = kapitan
  a chief     = sardor
  a necklace  = marjon
  barefoot    = yalang oyoq
  boots       = etik
  Native American = Amerika tub aholisi

exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  B by ship
   2  B dog
   3  A a raccoon
   4  B waterfall
   5  B serious
   6  C gold
   7  A biscuits
   8  B Thomas
   9  A Chief Powhatan
  10  A food
  11  B England


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  'How does Captain John Smith get to the
     New World?' → BY ShIP
    1607-yilda Amerikaga faqat KEMADA
    borish mumkin edi.
    ⚠ 'by jeep' va 'by plane' — TARIXIY
    TUZOQ! O'shanda na jip, na samolyot
    bor edi.

 2  'Percy is Governor Ratcliffe's ...'
    → DOG
    Persi — Ratkliffning erkalatgan IT
    (mopsi).

 3  'What kind of animal is Meeko?'
    → A RACCOON
    Miko — YENOT, Pokaxontasning do'sti.
    ⚠ 'a raccoon' = yenot (Amerika
    hayvoni).

 4  'Pocahontas first meets John Smith by
     the side of a ...' → WATERFALL
    Ular ShARShARA yonida uchrashadi.

 5  'Pocahontas doesn't want to marry
     Kocoum because he's too ...'
    → SERIOUS
    Kokoum juda JIDDIY — Pokaxontas esa
    erkin, quvnoq.
    ⚠ 'too + sifat' = haddan tashqari.

 6  'The soldiers go to the New World to
     find ...' → GOLD
    ⚠ Bu — filmning ASOSIY sababi.
    Ratkliff oltin qidiradi va yerni
    qazib buzadi.
    (3-mashqdagi 'destroy the land' shu
     haqida!)

 7  'What does Meeko take from John Smith?'
    → BISCUITS
    Yenot Miko Jonning pechenyesini
    o'g'irlaydi — ular shunday tanishadi.
    ⚠ 4-mashqda 'biscuits' ASKARLAR
    tomoniga tushadi.

 8  'Who shoots Kocoum?' → THOMAS
    Tomas — yosh askar. U Kokoumni otib
    o'ldiradi. Shundan keyin urush
    boshlanadi.

 9  'Who was John trying to save when
     Governor Ratcliffe shot him?'
    → CHIEF POWHATAN
    Ratkliff sardorni otmoqchi bo'ladi,
    Jon uni to'sib qoladi va o'zi
    yaralanadi.
    ⚠ 'was trying' — PAST CONTINUOUS.

10  'What do the Indians bring for the
     soldiers?' → FOOD
    Hindular OVQAT olib kelishadi (do'stlik
    belgisi).
    ⚠ 4-mashqda 'corn' (makkajo'xori)
    HINDULAR tomonida.

11  'Where does John Smith go at the end of
     the film?' → ENGLAND
    Jon yaralanadi va davolanish uchun
    Angliyaga qaytadi. Pokaxontas qoladi.


⚠ 1-BAND — TARIXIY TUZOQ:

  Film 1607-yilda bo'lib o'tadi.

     'by JEEP'  — jip 20-asrda paydo
        bo'lgan
     'by PLANE' — samolyot 1903-yilda
        uchgan
     'by SHIP'  ✓ — yagona mumkin javob

  ⚠ 84-betdagi 'gold watch' va 85-betdagi
  'TV' bilan BIR XIL turdagi tuzoq!


⚠ 9-BAND GRAMMATIKASI:

  'Who WAS John TRYING to save WHEN
   Governor Ratcliffe SHOT him?'

  ⚠ IKKI ZAMON bir gapda:
     'was trying' — PAST CONTINUOUS
        (davom etayotgan harakat)
     'shot' — PAST SIMPLE
        (to'satdan sodir bo'lgan ish)

  Qolip: 'was/were + V-ing ... WHEN +
  [2-shakl]'

  6-nazorat testi, 9-band: 'She was in the
  kitchen WHEN the doorbell RANG.'


⚠ EGALIK ShAKLI (2-band):
  'Governor Ratcliffe'S dog'
  Ism '-e' bilan tugagan → apostrof + s.


DIQQAT — 'TO SHOOT':
  'to shoot' = otmoq (o'q bilan)
  shoot → SHOT → shot

  ⚠ 'shoot somebody' = kimnidir otmoq
  ⚠ 'shoot a film' = film suratga olmoq
    (boshqa ma'no!)


DIQQAT — 'TO MARRY':
  'to marry somebody' = kimgadir uylanmoq /
     turmushga chiqmoq

  ⚠ Predlog YO'Q:
     'marry Kocoum'      ✓
     'marry WITH Kocoum' ✗

  'to get married TO somebody' — bu shaklda
  'to' bor.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a ship      = kema
  a governor  = gubernator
  a raccoon   = yenot
  a waterfall = sharshara
  to marry    = uylanmoq, turmushga chiqmoq
  serious     = jiddiy
  gold        = oltin
  a biscuit   = pechenye
  to shoot    = otmoq
  to save     = qutqarmoq
  to bring    = olib kelmoq

exercises.instructionEn: Tick which of the following activities the Indians do.
exercises.instructionUz: Hindular quyidagi ishlardan qaysilarini qilishini belgilang.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI ISh:

  ✓ catch fish       (baliq tutish)
  ✓ gather food      (ovqat yig'ish)
  ✓ tell stories     (hikoya aytish)
  ⚠ kill animals     (hayvon o'ldirish) —
                     MUNOZARALI
  ✓ paddle canoes    (kanoe eshish)
  ✗ destroy the land (yerni buzish)


⚠ KITOB JAVOBLARNI BOSMAGAN.


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 ✓ CATCH FISH — hindular daryodan baliq
   tutadi (ovqatning asosiy manbai).

 ✓ GATHER FOOD — ular makkajo'xori
   yetishtiradi va meva yig'adi.
   ⚠ 4-mashqda 'CORN' hindular tomonida.

 ✓ TELL STORIES — Grandmother Willow
   (Buvi Tol) Pokaxontasga donishmandlik
   hikoyalarini aytadi.
   ⚠ Hikoya aytish — tub aholi
   madaniyatining muhim qismi (yozuv
   o'rniga).

 ✓ PADDLE CANOES — kanoe ularning asosiy
   transporti.
   ⚠ 4-mashqda 'CANOE' hindular tomonida.
   ⚠ Workbook 60-bet, 3-mashq: 'CANOES are
   a primitive means of transport.'

 ✗ DESTROY THE LAND — bu ASKARLAR ishi!
   Ratkliff oltin qidirib yerni qazib
   buzadi (2-mashqning 6-bandi).
   Hindular esa tabiatni asraydi.


⚠ 'KILL ANIMALS' — MUNOZARALI BAND:

  IKKI QARASh BOR:

  ✓ HA deb belgilash mumkin:
     Filmda Kokoum va boshqa erkaklar OV
     qiladi. Ovqat uchun hayvon o'ldirish —
     ularning hayot tarzi.

  ✗ YO'Q deb belgilash ham mumkin:
     Mashqning maqsadi — hindularning
     tabiat bilan UYG'UN yashashini
     ko'rsatish. Ular kerak bo'lgandan
     ortiq o'ldirmaydi, askarlar esa
     beparvo otadi.

  ⚠ Kitob javobni bosmagani uchun ikkalasi
  ham himoya qilinadi. Muhimi — SABABINI
  tushuntirish.


⚠ MAShQNING ASOSIY G'OYASI:

  Bu mashq ikki hayot tarzini
  taqqoslaydi:

     HINDULAR — tabiatdan OLADI, lekin
        uni asraydi (fish, food, canoes)
     ASKARLAR — tabiatni BUZADI (destroy
        the land)

  Muhokamaning 1 va 2-savollari aynan shu
  haqida.


⚠ 'GATHER' va 'COLLECT' FARQI:
  'to gather food' = ovqat yig'moq
     (tabiatdan)
  'to collect stamps' = marka to'plamoq
     (kolleksiya)


⚠ 'A CANOE' va 'TO PADDLE':
  'a canoe' /kəˈnuː/ = kanoe (uzun tor
     qayiq)
  'to paddle' = eshkak eshmoq (kanoeda)
  'to row' = eshkak eshmoq (oddiy qayiqda)

  ⚠ Coursebook 113-bet, 5-mashq:
  'a ROWING BOAT' — eshkakli qayiq.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to catch fish = baliq tutmoq
  to gather   = yig'moq
  to tell stories = hikoya aytmoq
  to kill     = o'ldirmoq
  to paddle   = eshkak eshmoq (kanoeda)
  a canoe     = kanoe
  to destroy  = buzmoq, vayron qilmoq
  land        = yer, tuproq

⚠ QUYIDAGI BANDLAR O'YINGA QO'ShILMADI - ularning javobi
kitobda YO'Q (audio yoki manba kerak):
  * kill animals - ⚠ MUNOZARALI

exercises.instructionEn: Sort out the following words into the correct boxes: SOLDIERS / INDIANS — ship, arrow, helmet, head-dress, gun, canoe, corn, biscuits
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi so'zlarni to'g'ri katakchalarga taqsimlang: ASKARLAR / HINDULAR
exercises.explanationUz:
SAKKIZ SO'Z — HAR TOMONGA TO'RTTADAN:

╔═════════════════╦═════════════════╗
║ SOLDIERS        ║ INDIANS         ║
║ (askarlar)      ║ (hindular)      ║
╠═════════════════╬═════════════════╣
║ ship  (kema)    ║ canoe (kanoe)   ║
║ helmet (dubulg'a)║ head-dress     ║
║                 ║   (patli bosh   ║
║                 ║    kiyimi)      ║
║ gun   (miltiq)  ║ arrow (o'q,     ║
║                 ║        kamon o'qi)║
║ biscuits        ║ corn            ║
║   (pechenye)    ║   (makkajo'xori)║
╚═════════════════╩═════════════════╝


⚠ HAR JUFTLIK BIR XIL VAZIFANI BAJARADI:

  TRANSPORT:
     askarlar — ShIP (kema, okean orqali)
     hindular — CANOE (kanoe, daryo
        orqali)

  BOSh KIYIMI:
     askarlar — HELMET (metall dubulg'a,
        himoya uchun)
     hindular — HEAD-DRESS (patli bosh
        kiyimi, martaba belgisi)

  QUROL:
     askarlar — GUN (o'q otar qurol)
     hindular — ARROW (kamon o'qi)

  OVQAT:
     askarlar — BISCUITS (pechenye,
        Yevropadan)
     hindular — CORN (makkajo'xori,
        Amerikada o'sadi)


⚠ BU JADVAL 87-BETDAGI JADVAL BILAN
O'XShASh:

  87-bet (Highlander): 16-asr ↔ 20-asr
  88-bet (Pocahontas): askarlar ↔ hindular

  Ikkalasi ham IKKI DUNYONI taqqoslaydi.


HAR SO'Z HAQIDA:

  SHIP — 2-mashqning 1-bandi: 'How does
     John Smith get to the New World? —
     BY SHIP.'

  CANOE — 3-mashq: 'paddle canoes'.
     ⚠ Workbook 60-bet: 'Canoes are a
     primitive means of transport.'

  HELMET — askarlar metall dubulg'a
     kiyadi (rasmda ham ko'rinadi).

  HEAD-DRESS — patlardan yasalgan bosh
     kiyimi. Sardor va jangchilar kiyadi.
     ⚠ Har pat MARTABANI bildiradi.

  GUN — 2-mashqning 8-bandi: 'Who ShOOTS
     Kocoum? — THOMAS.' (miltiq bilan)

  ARROW — kamon o'qi. Hindularning quroli.
     ⚠ 'a bow and arrow' = kamon va o'q.

  BISCUITS — 2-mashqning 7-bandi: 'What
     does Meeko take from John Smith? —
     BISCUITS.'

  CORN — 2-mashqning 10-bandi: 'What do
     the Indians bring for the soldiers? —
     FOOD.' (makkajo'xori)
     ⚠ Makkajo'xori — AMERIKA o'simligi.
     Yevropaliklar uni Amerikadan bilib
     olishgan!


⚠ 'CORN' — IKKI MA'NO:

  AMERIKADA: 'corn' = makkajo'xori
  BRITANIYADA: 'corn' = don (umuman
     bug'doy, arpa)

  Britaniyada makkajo'xori — 'MAIZE' yoki
  'sweetcorn'.

  ⚠ Bu yerda AMERIKA ma'nosida.


⚠ 'A HEAD-DRESS' — DEFIS BILAN:
  'a head-dress' = bosh kiyimi

  Ikki so'zdan yasalgan qo'shma ot:
     head + dress

  Shunga o'xshash: a hat-stand (85-bet),
  a pen-friend (85-bet).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a ship      = kema
  a canoe     = kanoe
  a helmet    = dubulg'a
  a head-dress = patli bosh kiyimi
  a gun       = o'q otar qurol
  an arrow    = o'q (kamon o'qi)
  a bow       = kamon
  corn        = makkajo'xori (AmE)
  maize       = makkajo'xori (BrE)
  a biscuit   = pechenye

tasks.right: SOLDIERS: helmet (dubulg'a)   |   INDIANS: head-dress (patli bosh kiyimi)

exercises.explanationUz:
UChTA OChIQ SAVOL:

 1  'The Indians wanted to protect their
     land. Were they right? Give reasons.'
    = Hindular o'z yerlarini himoya
      qilmoqchi edi. Ular haq edimi?
      Sabablarini keltiring.

 2  'Describe the differences between the
     soldiers and the Indians.'
    = Askarlar va hindular orasidagi
      farqlarni tasvirlang.

 3  'In real life, Pocahontas went to live
     in England. Talk about the differences
     between her life there and her life in
     Virginia.'
    = Haqiqiy hayotda Pokaxontas Angliyaga
      yashash uchun ketgan. Uning u
      yerdagi va Virjiniyadagi hayoti
      orasidagi farqlar haqida gapiring.


1-SAVOL — NAMUNA JAVOB:

  'Yes, I think they were right. It was
   their land — they lived there before
   the soldiers came. The soldiers wanted
   to take the gold and they destroyed the
   land. The Indians only took what they
   needed from nature.'

  Tarjimasi:
  'Ha, menimcha ular haq edi. Bu ularning
   yeri edi — askarlar kelishidan oldin
   ular u yerda yashardi. Askarlar oltin
   olmoqchi edi va yerni buzdi. Hindular
   esa tabiatdan faqat keragini olardi.'

  ⚠ 'to protect' = himoya qilmoq
  ⚠ 'Give reasons' = sabablarini ayting


2-SAVOL — 4-MAShQ TAYYOR JAVOB BERADI:

  'The soldiers came BY SHIP; the Indians
   travel BY CANOE.
   The soldiers wear HELMETS; the Indians
   wear HEAD-DRESSES.
   The soldiers have GUNS; the Indians have
   BOWS AND ARROWS.
   The soldiers eat BISCUITS; the Indians
   eat CORN.

   The soldiers want GOLD and they DESTROY
   the land. The Indians PROTECT the land.'

  ⚠ TAQQOSLASh QOLIPI:
     'The soldiers ..., but the Indians ...'
     'The soldiers ...; the Indians ...'


3-SAVOL — TARIXIY HAQIQAT:

  ⚠ Bu savol 'IN REAL LIFE' deydi, ya'ni
  FILMDAN emas, TARIXDAN so'raydi.

  ⚠ MUHIM: Disney filmi tarixni ancha
  o'zgartirgan.

  TARIXIY FAKTLAR:

     • Pokaxontasning haqiqiy ismi —
       MATOAKA. 'Pokaxontas' — laqab.
     • U taxminan 1596-yilda tug'ilgan.
     • U Jon Smitga emas, JON ROLFGA
       (John Rolfe) turmushga chiqqan
       (1614-yil).
     • 1616-yilda Angliyaga ketgan.
     • 1617-yilda Angliyada, Greyvzend
       shahrida vafot etgan — taxminan
       21 yoshida.

  ⚠ Ya'ni u Angliyada faqat BIR YILChA
  yashagan.


  IKKI HAYOT TARZINING FARQI:

  VIRJINIYADA (tug'ilgan yurtida):
     • ochiq havoda, o'rmon va daryo
       yonida
     • an'anaviy kiyim (jigarrang ko'ylak,
       yalang oyoq)
     • kanoeda yurish, baliq tutish
     • o'z oilasi va qabilasi bilan

  ANGLIYADA:
     • katta shahar (London), sovuq
       ob-havo
     • yevropacha kiyim (og'ir ko'ylak,
       shlyapa, poyabzal)
     • aravada yurish
     • begona odamlar orasida, o'z tilida
       gaplashadigan kishisiz

  ⚠ Bu farqlar 87-betdagi 16-asr/20-asr
  jadvali kabi taqqoslanadi.


⚠ TAQQOSLASh UChUN GRAMMATIKA:

  'In Virginia she WORE ..., but in England
   she WORE ...'
  'Her life in Virginia WAS ..., but her
   life in England WAS ...'
  'In Virginia there WERE ...; in England
   there WEREN'T ...'

  → PAST SIMPLE (Unit 9 grammatikasi)


DIQQAT — 'INDIANS' SO'ZI HAQIDA:

  Kitob 'Indians' so'zini ishlatadi.

  ⚠ Bu nom XATODAN kelib chiqqan: Kolumb
  Amerikaga yetganda o'zini HINDISTONDA
  deb o'ylagan va tub aholini 'Indians'
  deb atagan.

  Hozirgi to'g'riroq atamalar:
     'Native Americans' (Amerika tub
        aholisi)
     'Indigenous peoples'

  ⚠ 2-mashqning 11-bandidagi 'India'
  varianti ham shu chalkashlikka ishora.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to protect  = himoya qilmoq
  a reason    = sabab
  a difference = farq
  in real life = haqiqiy hayotda
  Virginia    = Virjiniya (AQSh shtati)
  nature      = tabiat
  a tribe     = qabila
  Native Americans = Amerika tub aholisi

tasks.en: 1  The Indians wanted to protect their land. Were they right?  —  Yes. It was their land. The soldiers wanted the gold and destroyed the land.
tasks.uz: 1 Hindular yerlarini himoya qilmoqchi edi. Ular haq edimi? — Ha. Bu ularning yeri edi. Askarlar oltin istardi va yerni buzdi.
tasks.note:
OCHIQ JAVOBLI, lekin dalil keltirish shart
('Give reasons').

QOLIP: 'I think they were right BECAUSE ...'

2-mashqning 6-bandi va 3-mashqdagi 'destroy
the land' — tayyor dalil.

tasks.en: 2  Describe the differences: The soldiers came by ship; the Indians travel by canoe. The soldiers have guns; the Indians have bows and arrows.
tasks.uz: 2 Farqlarni tasvirlang: Askarlar kemada keldi; hindular kanoeda yuradi. Askarlarda miltiq; hindularda kamon va o'q.
tasks.note:
⚠ 4-MASHQ TAYYOR JAVOB BERADI — jadvalning
har juftligini gapga aylantiring.

QOLIP: 'The soldiers ..., BUT the Indians ...'

tasks.en: 3  In real life: Pocahontas (real name Matoaka) married John Rolfe in 1614, went to England in 1616, and died there in 1617, aged about 21.
tasks.uz: 3 Haqiqiy hayotda: Pokaxontas (asl ismi Matoaka) 1614-yilda Jon Rolfga turmushga chiqqan, 1616-yilda Angliyaga ketgan va 1617-yilda u yerda taxminan 21 yoshida vafot etgan.
tasks.note:
⚠ Bu savol 'IN REAL LIFE' deydi — FILMDAN
emas, TARIXDAN so'raydi.

⚠ Disney filmi tarixni ancha o'zgartirgan:
haqiqatda u Jon SMITGA emas, Jon ROLFGA
turmushga chiqqan va Angliyada faqat bir
yilcha yashagan.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The soldiers have guns, but the Indians have bows and arrows.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Askarlarda miltiq bor, lekin hindularda kamon va o'q bor.

Taqqoslash qolipi — 4-mashq jadvalining har
juftligi shunga tushadi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Who was John trying to save when Governor Ratcliffe shot him?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Gubernator Ratkliff otganda Jon kimni qutqarmoqchi edi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Past Continuous (davom etayotgan) +
Past Simple (to'satdan sodir bo'lgan).

sentencePatterns.formula: [ega] doesn't want to MARRY [kim] BECAUSE he's TOO + [sifat].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Pocahontas doesn't want to marry Kocoum because he's too serious.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Pokaxontas Kokoumga turmushga chiqishni istamaydi, chunki u juda jiddiy.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'MARRY somebody' — predlog YO'Q.
'TOO + sifat' = haddan tashqari (salbiy).
